paper: FinPos: A Position-Aware Trading Agent System for Real Financial Markets
headline_strategy: FinPos filters and analyzes daily price, company/macro news and filings into hierarchical memory, then a GPT-4o Direction Agent and Quantity/Risk Agent jointly update a carried integer position; future 1/7/30-day price changes provide a training-only reflection reward and a 20-day CVaR reference is intended to cap trade quantity.
headline_selection_basis: Sections 3-4 define the position-aware dual-agent policy with hierarchical memory and multi-timescale reward as FinPos. The printed return/reward/risk equations are training/accounting components, not a standalone action rule.

paper_configuration.quantity: integer intended to be capped by 95% CVaR
paper_configuration.training_reward: -(M_t)^2 when position is unchanged, else pos_t*M_t

missing_headline_objects: the signal-filtering and analyst implementations and domain heuristics
hierarchical-memory allocation, retrieval, scoring, migration and persistence
the Direction Agent and Quantity/Risk Agent runtime prompts, responses and parser
the GPT-4o revision/API configuration, seeds and repeated trajectories
a dimensionally defined conversion from CVaR return/PnL to integer share quantity
initial cash/positions, account-value definition, leverage/shorting limits and liquidation
decision/fill timing, price, fees, spread, slippage and borrowing rules
immutable Yahoo/Finnhub/EDGAR rows, query timestamps and point-in-time alignment
daily actions, quantities, orders, fills, positions, PnL and account paths
the result generator, CR-percent mapping, metric conventions and uncertainty protocol
material_paper_conflicts: The reward uses total position rather than trade direction or position change, so a Sell can receive a positive rising-market reward while the account remains long.
Raw-dollar multi-horizon differences make the reward asset-price-scale dependent.
The 95% lower-tail CVaR convention, sign interpretation and conversion to shares conflict or are missing.
The printed log-return sum has no mapping to displayed CR percentages.
V2 figures retain v1 Calmar annotations despite changed v2 returns.
The v2 extreme-test period and U.S.-election timing conflict across sections/captions.

rejected_substitutes.reason: It uses future 1/7/30-day prices as a training reward and is explicitly unavailable at test time; treating it as an action is lookahead.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use the paper-derived position/reward/CVaR equations as a strategy
rejected_substitutes.reason: They account for state or training feedback but do not choose direction or a dimensionally valid quantity.

rejected_substitutes.route: Run the printed prompts through a current GPT-4o endpoint
rejected_substitutes.reason: Six JSON examples are invalid, two depend on an unreleased suffix, and the memory/input/runtime/model lineage remains absent.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use a generic position-aware momentum/risk JKP proxy
rejected_substitutes.reason: No paper rule selects its characteristics, signs, or portfolio mapping, so it would be a thematic researcher strategy.

rejected_substitutes.route: Infer actions from tables or static figures
rejected_substitutes.reason: Aggregate and stale-revision outputs do not identify daily directions, quantities, costs or account paths.

result_policy: No future reward score, paper-derived accounting component, current-model prompt completion, thematic proxy, or backcast output is entered as a FinPos monthly return.
